section.name: Full Day Experience
section.purpose: Show what happens during the 6-hour private workshop as a clear four-step journey from the student's initial idea to a real live website.

notes: This section is intentionally long and should extend beyond one viewport.
The four steps should feel like one continuous learning journey.
Alternate text and visual positions between rows to create rhythm.
Do not compress the four steps into cards.

codex_constraints: DESIGN_SYSTEM.md is the global styling source of truth.
Use the global 1280px container.
Use Noto Sans Thai from the global typography system.
Normal body copy uses font-weight 300.
Use #FA5001 as the full section background through the global accent token.
This is a full orange section.
Do not convert the four steps into cards.
Do not place all four steps into a single horizontal row.
Use four vertically stacked full-width rows.
Preserve the alternating text/visual pattern on desktop.
Step 01: text left, visual right.
Step 02: visual left, text right.
Step 03: text left, visual right.
Step 04: visual left, text right.
Each row should feel spacious and editorial.
Use subtle structural divider lines between rows if required.
Do not use white card containers behind each step.
The orange background must remain visible throughout the entire section.
Do not force this section into 100vh.
Use real approved text and supplied visual assets during direct implementation.
Use placeholders for website screenshots, reference boards, UI screenshots and icons only when their approved assets are missing.
Use approved final artwork when supplied; do not invent artwork that has not been approved.
Treat desktop as the current primary target; defer responsive QA until requested.
Do not invent additional curriculum items.
Do not revert any 6-hour copy back to 4 hours.
Do not invent section-specific typography, spacing, colors, radii or breakpoints when DESIGN_SYSTEM.md already defines them.
